system.description:
Your presence is no longer needed to sustain the phantasms you weave; they linger on their own after you have gone.

Once you have crafted an illusion, you may grant it Permanency by expending a Blood Trait. The illusion then persists until you dismiss it or someone pierces it. An illusion may carry both Apparition and Permanency, but each requires its own Blood Trait. Permanency works only on illusions created by Chimerstry. Subterfuge serves for retests of this Discipline.
